<td class="pl" style="border-bottom: 0px;" valign="top"><a class="a" href="javascript:void(0);" onclick="Show.showAR( this, 'defref_us-gaap_LesseeOperatingLeasesTextBlock', window );">LEASES</a></td>
<td class="text"><p id="xdx_809_eus-gaap--LesseeOperatingLeasesTextBlock_z31eRqj2Kq94" style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><b>NOTE 6: <span id="xdx_82A_zy2Ib8p87MT5">LEASES</span></b></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">The Company leases its corporate office in
Broomfield, Colorado and a warehouse facility in Denver, Colorado, along with certain office equipment, under operating lease agreements
that expire at various dates through 2031. As of June 30, 2026, the Company had operating lease right-of-use assets of $<span id="xdx_909_eus-gaap--OperatingLeaseRightOfUseAsset_c20260630_pp0p" title="Operating lease right-of-use assets">1,824,887</span> and
total operating lease liabilities of $<span id="xdx_905_eus-gaap--OperatingLeaseLiability_c20260630_pp0p" title="Operating lease liabilities">2,013,797</span>, consisting of $<span id="xdx_90A_eus-gaap--OperatingLeaseLiabilityCurrent_c20260630_pp0p" title="Operating lease liabilities current">867,393</span> classified as current and $<span id="xdx_905_eus-gaap--OperatingLeaseLiabilityNoncurrent_c20260630_pp0p" title="Operating lease liabilities long-term">1,146,404</span> classified as long-term.
As of December 31, 2025, the Company had operating lease right-of-use assets of $<span id="xdx_90E_eus-gaap--OperatingLeaseRightOfUseAsset_c20251231_pp0p" title="Operating lease right-of-use assets">2,193,211</span> and total operating lease liabilities of $<span id="xdx_900_eus-gaap--OperatingLeaseLiability_c20251231_pp0p" title="Operating lease liabilities">2,407,302</span>,
consisting of $<span id="xdx_909_eus-gaap--OperatingLeaseLiabilityCurrent_c20251231_pp0p" title="Operating lease liabilities current">807,749</span> classified as current and $<span id="xdx_900_eus-gaap--OperatingLeaseLiabilityNoncurrent_c20251231_pp0p" title="Operating lease liabilities long-term">1,599,553</span> classified as long-term.</p>



<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify"></p>



<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: center"></p>


<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">&#160;</p>
